# BeyondTrucks (BeyondTrucks Inc.)

BeyondTrucks is a Transportation, Logistics, Supply Chain and Storage company. BeyondTrucks is a Transportation Management System providing software for shippers & trucking companies looking to automate workflows and reduce administrative overhead. BeyondTrucks employs 25 people, founded in 2019. Headquartered in San Francisco, California, United States, with an office in San Mateo. Its workforce is distributed across United States, Philippines, and China. Has $4M in total funding, with 2 prior funding rounds.
